_comment: What the store actually charges, in the currency it can actually charge.
Printful prices in USD and PayFast settles only in South African rand — a
Reserve Bank requirement, not a PayFast choice — so a page showing dollars
and a payment link charging rand were two different numbers in front of the
same customer. The selling price is a decision, not a currency conversion,
so it lives here rather than being read off the supplier.
Printful stays the source of what EXISTS: sizes, colours, the blank, the
size guide. This file is the source of what it COSTS.
usdToZar: the rate used to turn Printful's USD retail prices into rand.
Set it above the spot rate: Printful bills in dollars, so the exchange risk
between an order and its invoice is yours. While it is null nothing has a
price and no product can be bought — which is correct, because a price that
cannot be charged is worse than no price at all.
deliveryUsd: worldwide delivery, in dollars, added to the supplier price
BEFORE conversion. Printful quotes $4.79 to the UK and $12.49 to South
Africa for this shirt, so one number covering the worst case goes here
rather than into Printful’s own retail prices — which stay a supplier
figure, and stay untouched. See /policies/ for what customers are told.
roundUpTo: rands. Converted prices are rounded UP to this, never down.
overrides: a deliberate rand price for one size, keyed by Printful product
id then size. Beats the conversion. Use it when a number should be chosen
rather than calculated.
Delivery is included in these prices — see /policies/. The worldwide markup
is already in whatever figure is set here.
This file is hand-edited and committed. Nothing generates it.
